statement: Whenever `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns a result `r`, `r = true` if and only if there exists a root-to-leaf path in `root` whose sequence of node values equals `arr`. That is, there exists a sequence of nodes `n_0, n_1, ..., n_{k-1}` such that `k = len(arr)`, `n_0 = root`, `n_{k-1}` is a leaf (i.e., `n_{k-1} = Tree.Node(v, Tree.Null, Tree.Null)` for some integer `v`), for each `i` with `0 <= i < k-1`, `n_{i+1}` is a child of `n_i` (either the left or the right child), and for each `i` with `0 <= i < k`, the value of `n_i` equals `arr[i]`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.

statement: For every tree `root` and every slice `arr` satisfying the preconditions, `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns a result (i.e., it does not fail with overflow, out-of-bounds, or panic).
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.
`1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; `root = Tree.Null`.

statement: If `root` is a single leaf node with value `v`, then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `true` if and only if `len(arr) = 1` and `arr[0] = v`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; `root = Tree.Node(v, Tree.Null, Tree.Null)` for some integer `v` with `0 <= v <= 9`.

statement: If `len(arr) = 1`, then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `true` if and only if `root = Tree.Node(arr[0], Tree.Null, Tree.Null)`. That is, the root itself must be a leaf (no children) and its value must equal `arr[0]`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; `len(arr) = 1`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.

statement: Let `height(root)` be defined by `height(Tree.Null) = 0` and `height(Tree.Node(_, l, r)) = 1 + max(height(l), height(r))`. If `len(arr) > height(root)`, then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `false`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.

statement: Let `min_depth(root)` be defined for a non-null tree as follows: if `root = Tree.Node(v, Tree.Null, Tree.Null)`, then `min_depth(root) = 1`; if exactly one child is non-null (say `Tree.Node(v, child, Tree.Null)` or `Tree.Node(v, Tree.Null, child)`), then `min_depth(root) = 1 + min_depth(child)`; if both children are non-null, then `min_depth(root) = 1 + min(min_depth(left), min_depth(right))`. If `len(arr) < min_depth(root)`, then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `false`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; `root` is not `Tree.Null`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.

`1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; `root = Tree.Node(v, _, _)` for some integer `v` with `0 <= v <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.

statement: If `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `true`, then there exists a root-to-leaf path in `root` whose sequence of node values equals `arr`. That is, there exists a sequence of nodes `n_0, n_1, ..., n_{k-1}` such that `k = len(arr)`, `n_0 = root`, `n_{k-1}` is a leaf, for each `i` with `0 <= i < k-1`, `n_{i+1}` is a child of `n_i`, and for each `i` with `0 <= i < k`, the value of `n_i` equals `arr[i]`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.

statement: Under the precondition that `root` is non-null and every node has at most one child, the tree has exactly one root-to-leaf path. Let that path's value sequence be `seq` (a list of length `k`, where `k` is the number of nodes on the path). Then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `true` if and only if `arr` equals `seq` (i.e., `len(arr) = k` and for all `i` with `0 <= i < k`, `arr[i] = seq[i]`).
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive; `root != Tree.Null`; every node in `root` has at most one child (i.e., for every node `Tree.Node(_, l, r)`, either `l = Tree.Null` or `r = Tree.Null`).

statement: If there is no root-to-leaf path in `root` of length exactly `len(arr)`, then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `false`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.

statement: Under the precondition that all node values and all elements of `arr` are equal to the same digit `v`, `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `true` if and only if there exists a root-to-leaf path in `root` of length `len(arr)`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; there exists an integer `v` with `0 <= v <= 9` such that every node in `root` has value `v` and every element of `arr` equals `v`.

statement: If `root` is a leaf and `len(arr) > 1`, then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `false`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; `root = Tree.Node(v, Tree.Null, Tree.Null)` for some integer `v` with `0 <= v <= 9`; `len(arr) > 1`.

statement: If there exists a root-to-leaf path in `root` whose sequence of node values equals `arr`, then `is_valid_sequence(root, arr)` returns `true`.
preconditions: `1 <= len(arr) <= 5000`; for all `i` with `0 <= i < len(arr)`, `0 <= arr[i] <= 9`; for every node in `root`, its value is between `0` and `9` inclusive.
